meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Radio-Locator home: tower artwork Show/Blur/Hide, hide the welcome blurb and footer links; the search forms always stay.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on radio-locator.com/. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (the page is plain responsive HTML, same markup expected [INFERRED]), search result pages (/cgi-bin/finder...), station pages (the network was out of resources when retried).

LIVE counts on Home: tower-blur desktop home 1; tower-hide desktop home 1; welcome-text desktop home 1; footer-links desktop home 4. No ad, iframe or cookie dialog existed on the home page, so the generic 1.0.0 rules match nothing live; any ads on result pages are NOT covered and no selector was invented for them. Readable class names only (bigscreen, welcome, footer_link).

Choice: Tower artwork Show/Blur/Hide (blur 6px). The search forms (`.sect0`..`.sect4`) are never hidden.
